notes.title: Milfy Cases .019 Reboot 2nd Update English Only
notes.content:
Hey there, I'm back with another update.

Before I get into the details, allow me to apologize for not yet localizing the new version of the game into other languages. I'll be doing that in the next week or so, which will include the .018 and the content of the .019 update editions. 

So what's in the game this time? Here is the summary:

7,100+ words in this edition, bringing the total in the reboot to over 12,000+ - we're about a quarter of the way, in terms of story, to match the prior edition before the reboot.

471 images in the game, and then another 20 images that are part of the achievements feature.

Four new in-game achievements and associated screens.

One new lore entry (If you see something that deserves a lore entry, I'm happy to add that as well, feel free to contact me here or discord, etc).

Two new character profiles for Sally and Alice, both of whom make their debut in this version of the game, which now includes all of the major, primary love interests. There will be some secondary characters & possible encounters with them, but the primary love interests for Milfy Cases are the ones in this episode, eg, Mary, Jenny, Sally, and Alice.

No new animation this time, but we do have 28 new audio files, including 1 new song and 27 sound effects. Also, I've cleaned up more of the legacy audio files to shrink the size of the game, so it's not bloated with old stuff that's not part of the current, new experience.

A bug fix related to the maxlovescore with Zara from the prior edition of the game.

As you could see from the .018, Winthrope Manor is a very large house, which is why Mary has not one but two maids helping her maintain the property. In this episode, we see more of the manor and we'll see even more as the story unfolds. Also, finally see Hope Springs and a few key business locations in the next update, expected to be ready at the end of September.

Thanks for playing,

Brosef Chungus

notes.title: .017 Bugfix and idle animation update
notes.content:
Hi all-

After multiple rounds of feedback for both Milfy Cases and the revamped Horny Holiday, I've updated all the idle animations in Milfy Cases to match the better received game. 

Additionally, there were numerous bug fixes including a few images that weren't correct for idle animations, the wrong speaker for a few lines of dialogue, and other minor audio improvements made for this update. 

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: Did you hear the one about the wizard, Chad? Let me tell you a story
notes.content:
Hey there-

Thanks for tuning in, we've made some major changes to the game from the very beginning, all the way through to the newest episode. Previously, the story didn't have enough coherence...and since the main character uses magic from the very beginning, let's make him a wizard from a far away land, in the regular world for the the first time.

There's even more in the story, but the highlights for this build include the following:

 About six thousand words of new story, including the revamped prologue, editorial changes throughout, and of course, the latest chapter.
 
 250+ images, including a few animations
 
 90+ new audio files...yes, that's right, there's the most audio I've ever added to a single update, since I went and retooled everything from the very beginning. I believe this makes it far more immersive, but you tell me.
 
 Last but not least, spelling, grammar, and other fixes from the beginning, which were more than a few, and an image or two that wasn't right, etc.


I'm optimistic the updates make the experience far more enjoyable and entertaining.

Cheers,
Brosef Chungus

notes.title: .016 Minor Update, new opacity slider feature
notes.content:
Hi all-

This was due to some reported issues on Discord (thank you all!) with an audio sound, updated; and the new preferences page feature of an opacity slider to change how much or little transparency there is in the text box background. Also a spelling issue from a prior update.

Thanks,
Brosef

notes.title: Milfy Cases .016 Edition
notes.content:
What's in the update? 
Other than the continuation of the story, I've had some personal issues that resulted in things being delayed longer than expected for this update. Life, unfortunately, doesn't always conform to our desires.


 197 new images
 Multiple new sound effects
 More story across multiple scenes
 An animated sexy scene with the first vaginal intercourse in the game. 
 All animated scenes converted to Webm from the previous frame animations which should result in better quality, less lag, and a better experience


Please enjoy, feedback welcome as always.

notes.title: Milfy Cases .015 Edition Release Notes
notes.content:
It's finally here! Without further ado, go play the update...but if you want to read what's in it first, here you go:


 224 images
 15 plus songs & new audio effects
 About 4,500 or so words of brand new story
 20 new animations
 Three different animated scenes, two of which vary depending on your choices, so to see both, you'd have to play twice with one of the variables from...much earlier in the game.
 Spelling, grammar, other edits & bug fixes since the last update
 Hopefully less new bugs (we'll see)
 In total, the game has over 1,450 images, 140 audio + sound files (about as many sound files as Her Heart's Desire), and 29,200+ words of story.


Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Image updates per bug reports, new language support
notes.content:
In addition to updating (almost) all the image updates to fix the issues reported this weekend, I've also added the newly localized versions of Milfy Cases in the following languages:

Brazilian Portuguese
Dutch
Italian
Russian
Turkish


Thanks again for all the feedback, I'm excited to have such supportive people enjoying my work.

notes.title: Cash variable update
notes.content: Maybe the last bug for this edition? :) Updated the cash variable which wasn't set previously, resulting in erroneous dialogue in the .014 update.

notes.title: Milfy Cases .014 Edition
notes.content:
Hey there, handsome, thanks for being a fan! I've got great news, the .014 edition is finally ready. Here's the highlights of this update and I'll be around anytime for bug fixes, etc, while I start working on the next episode. Cheers!


 Improvements to the intro, beginning text, and more changes in the first few updates as I scrubbed for poor quality audio, story improvements, and more.
 About four thousand new words of story
 211 new high quality images
 Eight different animations, one in a kissing scene, and another smaller animation elsewhere
 34 new sound effects, bringing the total to 113, vs the previous edition total of 79
 Multiple new scenes, solid character development, and story continuity improvements to ensure that the narrative is consistent where there was some issues with the job referring to his losing it before with the various characters.

notes.title: July 4th Update
notes.content: Hey there, the new update has over 200 new images, 19 animations, four new songs, and almost ten new sound effects. There's a full six thousand words of new story as well, bringing the total to over twenty thousand words in this edition. Last but not least, there are two new achievements as well.
